live.cost_reason: No trusted upstream pricing; unknown is not zero.
live.credential_selection: enabled local WorkBuddy WB_IN; no credential value recorded
live.execution_mode: live native FORGE Gateway and governed local tools
live.limitations: Failed and historical runs retain their original outcomes and source identities. An accepted earlier run does not certify later source. These totals exclude separate protocol probes and external diagnostics.
live.retry_metric_note: Historical snapshots without disjoint_event_counts_v2 retain recorded overlapping repair/review counts; do not interpret their sum as distinct retries. New v2 driver counters use separate durable events.
live.usage_aggregation_note: Reported token sums include only supplied charged values. Missing run statistics and unknown remote attempts prevent a complete usage total. The known unknown-attempt count is a lower bound when historical run statistics are missing; missing values are never proof of zero usage.

offline_algorithm_benchmark.limitations: Small fixed deterministic mechanism comparisons; no real task-quality/statistical generalization claim.

preservation.original_tests: 364/364 function identities retained; exact AST/assertion changes disclosed in the audit, not claimed byte-identical
preservation.phase1_evidence: 355/355 original evidence files byte-identical (340 earlier subset plus 15 hardening records)

actual_limits.limitation: Configured ceilings are operator safety bounds. The largest observed input was 2580 reported input tokens; no maximum-context or maximum-output boundary was measured. Two successful overlapping calls do not establish a service rate limit. No price evidence was supplied.

result.identity_limit: The local OpenAI-compatible proxy returned this model/provider identity. The probe does not independently verify which upstream model served the request.
result.publication_scope: Allowlisted measured fields from the existing sanitized report. No credential source, base URL, request content, response content, or logs are published. Protocol success is not Quest acceptance or a task-quality benchmark. This publication made no Provider request.

result.failure: A proxy/model response was received for the minimal dialogue case, but it failed exact expected-text equality. The response hash is retained; content is not published. No rerun replaced this failure.
result.publication_scope: Allowlisted measured fields from the existing sanitized report. No credential, base URL, request/response content or logs. Protocol success is not Quest acceptance or a task-quality benchmark. This publication made no Provider request. The earlier default-mode 11/11 probe remains separate.
result.reasoning_limit: Explicit request setting advertised by the local proxy implementation. Transmission and acceptance do not independently establish the upstream model's internal reasoning behavior.

reason: Strict live acceptance is reported per run; remaining requested capabilities and evaluation gaps prevent an overall completion claim.
remaining_limitations: General autonomous replanning of the remaining running DAG and hierarchical expansion remain incomplete.
Memory retrieval is lexical with bilingual aliases, not learned semantic retrieval.
Coding/experiments support fixed syntax/numeric tools and own-artifact revision, not arbitrary repository patch/test execution.
The independent reviewer uses the same approved model in a separate context; no model-diversity quality claim is made.
Complete message-specific ACP payload contracts and several online quality metrics remain incomplete.
Algorithm comparisons are fixed exploratory offline mechanism benchmarks, not equal-budget live task-quality gains.
Actual upstream model identity, context/output/rate maxima and prices remain unknown; configured ceilings are not measurements of service maxima.
Unknown in-flight remote outcomes remain fenced; they are never silently replayed or declared successful.
